confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Belgrade prices; no listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season and tax and fee treatment varies. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX value (0.6955, 2026-10-15) comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA overview page. I did not open that page, and two follow-up searches did not corroborate it, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis from general knowledge, with no web sources used for city prices: Belgrade restaurant and cafe prices sit near Sofia and Bucharest and somewhat below Budapest. Hostel and hotel anchors reflect central-Belgrade July demand, including taxes and mandatory fees.
